Teleport-sealed except sanctioned circles. For Shi'van operations: pure strategic backdrop. Yawning Portal surface interface = operational (Durnan/Mirt/witness-rumor feed). Below well-lip = not operational, no agents, no pursuit. Halaster not her problem (never engaged anything her campaign touches; engagement threshold = existential Waterdeep crisis = same threshold as Walking Statues walking = paired narrative ceilings). Xanathar Guild IS her problem indirectly (Mistshore recruitment → Skullport contractor pipeline → surface attacks). Harpers operate in Undermountain via Laeral institutional pathway (not currently operational). Drathen Baen'und historical polymath scholarship may touch Undermountain-adjacent material via Sage Kellam's Gallows-Marked research (latent). Benefits: absorbs adventurer-energy, keeps Xanathar center-of-mass below surface, maintains strategic ceiling effect, supports Yawning Portal commercial/intelligence venue. Overview entry; level-by-level detail (DotMM twenty-plus levels) deferred to future Locations DB expansion pass when campaign arc requires.

property_snapshot.Notes: Waterdeep's central commercial plaza. Castle Ward, bounded by the Yawning Portal/Street of Silks (north), Castle Waterdeep (south), Castle Ward commercial streets (east/west). Also known by older name Court of the White Bull after the carved stone bull at plaza center marking original dedication as cattle market. Octagonal, \~400 ft across, flagstone. Open sunrise to sundown; pre-dawn setup, peak 2nd morning bell through 8th evening bell. Waterdeep's principal public-information exchange alongside Yawning Portal and Font of Knowledge. The Celestial Compass Estate's kitchen supplies route through the Market via Aldren (cook, half-elf) shopping personally for discretion maintenance. Observer Network (Firth) rotates operatives through for ambient intelligence collection — what competitors say about Shi'van, what hardliner coalition broadsheet fronts publish, Dock Ward temperature reading. Session 8C Promethean Lamp Post public framing propagated through this vector. Citizens' Action League broadsheet fronts visible in information ring (hardliner coalition presence). Market is campaign ambient-texture layer — the city eats, argues, sells, gossips; Shi'van's operational problems exist alongside population that does not know about them and cares about bread pricing.
